clips.label: 2 paintings/s · baseline
clips.details:
New painting every 0.5s; 13 paintings including the opening.

Same brass-snail opening → shell with buildings → hollow pavilion → canyon city. Prompt events stay at 1.5s and 2.5s. Motion follows the same timed path and settles at 4s.

Krea Turbo, CFG 1, three Euler intervals. Starting noise: 0.40 → 0.78 → 0.64, scheduled in seconds. Every painting starts from the warped previous painting. Seeds match at shared half-seconds; extra quarter-seconds have their own repeatable seeds.

RIFE 4.25 scale 1 fills between paintings. 6.5 seconds, 24 fps, full resolution. No interpolation feeds back into generation.

Assistant painting review: the faster original-noise version opens a wider city; the lower-noise version keeps a large solid shell with a small central opening. Smaller repaint changes alone do not establish better morphing. Your playback preference is pending.
